title: BPW-2026-0582
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0582
CD 4
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 99 – GRUEN ASSOCIATES (GRUEN)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue the task to Gruen from the Pre-Qualified On-Call Architectural and Related Professional Services Consultants List to provide professional design and construction administration services for the Los Angeles River Greenway, East San Fernando Valley Gap Closure Project, from Whitsett Avenue to Lankershim Boulevard Project, as stated in TOS No. 99, with a budget authority of $7,933,409, including contingency.
(W.O.: E190752B, C-124702)
